messages:
jordan: Hey team, customer reported their SDK token estimator is ~30% lower than the API usage recorded on the invoice. They think they're being overbilled. Can someone help triage?
jen: Thanks — can you paste the request_id / model / sample payload they used? Also whether they used function calling or streaming.
jordan: Request id: req_01G9X2ABCDEF. Model: rwd-neo-rtl-1. Payload simplified: 
```
messages=[
  {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},
  {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following article... (2k chars)"}
]
```
They called python SDK estimate_tokens(api_key, messages) and got 850 tokens estimated. Invoice shows: prompt_tokens=1200, completion_tokens=400, total=1600.
maria: Quick note: SDK estimator tries to be cheap and sometimes omits model-specific special tokens, serialized metadata, and any tool/function outputs. If they used tools or had large assistant/system content, server counts can be higher.
sam: Can you confirm whether SDK call included function_call="auto" or any tool integrations? If the server invoked a tool, the function output is accounted in completion_tokens but client estimator may only count user+assistant messages prior to tool call.
jordan: Customer says they used function_call=auto and a tool returned a ~500 token JSON. SDK estimate didn't include that.
maria: That explains a big chunk. Repro steps I use: call the REST API and check the usage object vs sdk. Example REST response snippet we saw: 
```
{"id":"resp_...","usage":{"prompt_tokens":1200,"completion_tokens":400,"total_tokens":1600},"choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"","function_call":{"name":"fetch_data","arguments":"{...}"}},"finish_reason":"function_call"}]
```
When the function returns and we then send the function result back as assistant role, those tokens are part of completion on the server side. Our local estimator doesn't execute the tool so it misses those.
pete: For billing adjustments, we need to confirm whether the customer’s traffic is legitimate. If server usage matches their app logs, we typically don't credit unless there's a platform bug. Did they have repeated inflations that look like a runtime bug?
raj: Also check if they used streaming; streaming finalization may add trailing tokens (e.g., eos tokens, streaming delimiters) that SDK estimator might not add.
jen: Jordan — please provide a short sample capture (redact customer data) of SDK call + REST response + invoice lines. Also confirm if they were using an older SDK version. Sam — any known estimator bug?
sam: We had one bug pre-1.4.3 where estimator ignored system messages with >1024 chars and when function outputs were present. Fixed in 1.4.3. If customer used older SDK, estimator could be off by ~20-40% for some workloads.
jordan: Customer is on SDK v1.4.1. They sent minimal logs, attached in thread.
maria: Actionable: 1) Reproduce locally with their sanitized payload and function output (simulate tool response). 2) If we reproduce, recommend customer to upgrade to 1.4.3+ and re-run estimator. 3) If invoice still looks off after upgrade and reproduction, escalate to billing for credit review.
(10 minutes later)
maria: Reproduced. With the customer's payload + simulated function output (~480 tokens) I get estimator=820, server total=1605. Breakdown: prompt=1125 (includes system serialization & tool call wrapper), completion=480. Estimator omitted function output + some model-specific special tokens.
jordan: Shared repro with customer and recommended SDK upgrade. They asked if we can proactively patch estimator to count function outputs — any timeline?
sam: We can add a short-term fix to include function call placeholders in the estimator (cheap heuristic) — I'll open a patch. Long-term we should model tokenizer + tool output simulation per model. I'll create PR and aim for a minor release in 5 business days.
pete: Meanwhile, I'll provision a one-off invoice review for this account and hold any collection for disputed amount. If reproduction matches invoice and they refuse upgrade, we'll offer one-time courtesy credit if usage burst appears unexpected for their normal pattern.
jen: Please capture the customer impact note for the billing team.
(near end)
billing-bot: #action Created ticket BILL-4723 for invoice review (assigned to pete).
pete: Filed. Jordan — I'll update you after review.
jordan: Thanks. Customer upgraded to 1.4.3, re-ran estimator and numbers match much closer now (~5% delta). They accepted the SDK patch plan.
maria: Marking thread resolved unless billing needs more info.
jen: Closing on support side. :white_check_mark:
